why: Shell and nav is "Yes" (benchmark section 11), but the section 2 additive items were not exercised: a workspace switcher, favourites, a resizable rail. Today: `defineNav` (basalt-ui/router, src/router/nav/define-nav.ts) takes sections and a rail-bottom `pinned` list (`NavItemMeta`: id, label, short, icon, disabled, mobile, exact, activeWhen); the rail (src/shell/parts/rail.tsx) is 64 collapsed or 240 expanded (`RAIL_COLLAPSED_PX`, `RAIL_EXPANDED_PX`, src/shell/parts/grid.tsx), its collapse stored under `basalt:<storageKey>`; `RailAccount` (src/shell/parts/account.tsx) is the user menu; no workspace or favourite type exists.
what: A workspace switcher in the brand zone, a favourites section the user fills, and a rail the user resizes.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/shell/contract.ts and src/router/nav/** for the new props
packages/basalt-ui/src/page/record-panel.tsx only to host a favourite toggle
must_not_touch: the work surface and the frame (bench-surface shipped them; bench-theme-attributes owns the frame attribute)
the phone tab bar's model (README decision 9)
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md, sections 2 and 11. Decided: (1) `AppShell` takes an optional `workspace` (current, options with label and avatar or icon, `onSwitch`, an optional manage link): a switcher at the top of the rail in the brand zone, a `Menu` (basalt-ui/ui/menu) with the list, collapsing to the avatar at 64; on the phone it sits in the account sheet. (2) Favourites: a store port with a `persisted` default, a hook to toggle a `NavTarget` with label and icon, a toggle button for the record panel header and PageBar, and a Favourites section in the rail that shows only when it holds an entry, reorderable with `SortableList` (basalt-ui/ui/sortable-list). (3) The expanded rail resizes by a handle on its inner edge: pointer and keyboard separator with a value, double-click resets to the default width, a minimum and maximum from the ladder, the width persisted under the shell's `storageKey`; collapse to 64 stays as it is and the handle is absent at compact. (4) Collapsed items keep the tooltip with the shortcut. (5) The reference pages' nav gains a workspace and favourites so the shots show them.
reference: shell.md 2.1, 2.2, 3 and settings.md 2.11: sidebar 204 with a 180 menu column and a 6 px right-edge resize handle (`cursor-ew-resize`); collapse animates 204 to 64 over 0.3 s; collapsed items 28x28 with a tooltip carrying shortcut keycaps; workspace switcher a 148x32 button, popover 224 wide, radius 10, a SWITCH WORKSPACE label; user menu 224; favourites a group that appears once a record is favourited; settings can reorder the sidebar (dnd-kit, live preview). Phone: a 300 px left sheet, which we do not copy (README decision 9). Shots: shell/08-sidebar-workspace-switcher.png, shell/19-sidebar-collapsed-rail.png, shell/20-sidebar-collapsed-hover-tooltip.png, settings/26-sidebar-rest.png.
acceptance: The rail width survives a reload, resets on double-click, works by keyboard and respects its bounds (tests)
The workspace switcher switches through `onSwitch` and collapses to its avatar at 64 px
Favouriting a record from its panel adds it to a Favourites section that persists and reorders
At 390 px the tab bar is unchanged and the switcher sits in the account sheet
Frames of the reference pages with the new nav show no design-reviewer P1
out_of_scope: A user-ordered main nav, nav permissions, multi-account sign-in, a settings page for the sidebar.
proof: Frames from `basalt-ui shot` at 1800x1200 and 390x844, light and dark, attached to the PR, and the design reviewer run on them.
commits: Conventional, empty scope, packages/basalt-ui/** in its own commits. Never feat!: and no BREAKING CHANGE footer (docs/release.md). A changed or removed export updates migrations/areas and the generated docs in the same PR.
